name: recompute_w_u
description: Recompute Mamba/GLA W and U blocks from K/V, beta and a cumulative gate. k is [B,T,Hg,K], v is [B,T,H,V], beta and g_cumsum are [B,T,H] float32, and A is [B,T,H,BT] with BT equal to the block length. For each block of BT rows and each head h, with hk = h // (H // Hg), compute vb = v * beta, kb = k[:,hk] * beta * exp(g_cumsum), w = A_block @ kb and u = A_block @ vb; the matmuls are accumulated in float32 and cast back to k/v dtype. Returns (w [B,T,H,K], u [B,T,H,V]) as newly allocated tensors. cu_seqlens is required to be None; the varlen path is not implemented. Suites exercise bfloat16 k/v/A and float32 beta/g_cumsum.
